title: Gaussian rounding ratio bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on $n$ vertices with nonnegative symmetric weights summing to $1$ and zero diagonal, and let $U$ assign a unit vector in $ br^n$ to each vertex. The Goemans–Williamson constant times the SDP value of $U$ is at most the expected cut value obtained by Gaussian rounding, where the expectation is over $n$ independent standard Gaussian coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: The sum of all ordered-pair weights is $1$
